top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Gottardo. Practice on paved Alpine roads with historic cobblestone: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 71 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Gottardo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
10,656ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At Granfondo Gottardo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
150ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
10,656ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Gottardo. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,656ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
71 miles on paved Alpine roads with historic cobblestone burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Gottardo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Base fitness for Granfondo Gottardo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved Alpine roads with historic cobblestone can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Gottardo's 71 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Granfondo Gottardo includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. Three temperature swings from valley to summit — 15-20C differentials on each pass.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Gottardo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved alpine roads with historic cobblestone section to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 71 miles of paved alpine roads with historic cobblestone section in Ambri, Ticino, Switzerland.
